document.name: Portable Cassette Player
document.description: Compact personal stereo cassette player featuring a burnt-orange split enclosure with dark ruggedized corner bumpers, transparent inspection window, dual reel spindles, belt-driven capstan assembly, permalloy head bridge, and mechanical transport controls. Conceptual educational model.
document.provenance: AI generated conceptual assembly. Geometry, dimensions and specifications are illustrative; no CAD fit, wiring or hardware operation has been verified.

parts.name: Rear Enclosure Shell
parts.description: Burnt-orange rear housing with dark elastomer corner bumpers, internal mounting bosses, and lower battery bay walls.
parts.role: Primary structural chassis and rear protective enclosure

parts.name: Front Split Bezel
parts.description: Burnt-orange front frame with cassette loading opening, dark corner bumper caps, and side control cutouts.
parts.role: Front structural frame and cassette bay surround

parts.name: Transparent Tape Window Door
parts.description: Hinged cassette compartment door with burnt-orange outer frame, clear acrylic viewing window, and internal cassette stabilizer spring.
parts.role: Protects cassette while keeping reels and tape motion clearly visible

parts.name: Battery Compartment & AA Cells
parts.description: Removable lower rear door paired with two illustrative 1.5V AA cylindrical cells wired in series.

parts.name: Main Audio & Control PCB
parts.description: Green fiberglass circuit board holding the low-voltage preamplifier IC, electrolytic filter capacitors, motor governor circuit, and wire headers.
parts.role: Amplifies magnetic head signals and regulates drive motor speed

specs.Audio Path: Stereo tape head pre-amp + headphone driver

parts.name: 3V DC Micro Drive Motor
parts.description: Shielded brushed DC pancake motor with brass V-groove drive pulley and vibration-damping rubber mount.
parts.role: Provides rotational torque to the belt and capstan flywheel

parts.name: Capstan Flywheel & Drive Belt
parts.description: High-inertia zinc-alloy flywheel, precision ground stainless steel capstan shaft, and elastomer drive belt.
parts.role: Smooths motor speed variations and pulls tape at constant linear speed

parts.name: Left Supply Reel Spindle
parts.description: Six-splined white acetal hub spindle with dark backing gear and slip clutch.
parts.role: Supports and guides the left cassette supply hub

parts.name: Right Take-Up Reel Spindle
parts.description: Driven right-hand six-splined spindle assembly that winds magnetic tape after it passes the capstan.
parts.role: Winds played tape onto the right cassette hub

parts.name: Magnetic Head & Pinch Roller Bridge
parts.description: Sliding steel carriage holding the stereo permalloy playback head, tape guide forks, and pivoted rubber pinch roller.
parts.role: Advances into the cassette shell during Play to read tape and clamp the capstan

connections.label: Pinch roller presses tape to capstan

parts.name: Compact Cassette Tape
parts.description: Clear-shell compact audio cassette with dark magnetic tape packs, dual toothed reels, and orange/cream retro label.

connections.label: Top edge head and roller openings

parts.name: Play / Stop / FF Mechanical Controls
parts.description: Top-mounted mechanical pushbuttons with latching Play actuator, raised orange tactile cue, and internal slide plate.
parts.role: Mechanically engages the head bridge and switches motor power

parts.name: Side Rotary Volume Thumbwheel
parts.description: Knurled dark thumbwheel potentiometer mounted along the right housing edge with printed numeric scale.

parts.name: 3.5mm Stereo Headphone Socket
parts.description: Top-mounted 3.5mm TRS stereo jack with metallic collar and burnt-orange ring accent.
parts.role: Delivers analog stereo audio to external headphones

steps.title: Rugged Split Enclosure & Window Door
steps.description: The player is housed in a burnt-orange split ABS shell reinforced by four dark rounded corner bumpers. A hinged front door with a clear acrylic window frames the cassette bay.

steps.title: 3V Battery Compartment
steps.description: At the base of the rear shell, a removable latch cover holds two AA cells wired in series to provide 3V DC portable power.

steps.title: Audio & Speed-Governor Electronics
steps.description: The internal circuit board carries the stereo preamplifier, headphone driver, rotary volume thumbwheel, and 3.5mm stereo headphone socket.

steps.title: Belt-Driven Capstan Transport
steps.description: A 3V DC micro motor drives a rubber belt connected to a weighted zinc flywheel and precision capstan shaft, stabilizing tape speed while driving the right take-up spindle.

steps.title: Play Linkage & Head Engagement
steps.description: Pressing the top Play button mechanically advances the head and pinch roller bridge into the cassette tape, clamping the oxide ribbon against the spinning capstan for playback.

relationships.description: Two AA cells supply 3V DC power to the main audio and motor regulation board.
Pressing Play pushes the magnetic head and pinch roller carriage down into the cassette openings.
Leaf switch closure routes regulated 3V DC current to spin the micro drive motor.
Brass motor pulley drives the elastomer belt wrapped around the high-inertia capstan flywheel.
Capstan and intermediate gear train rotate the right take-up reel spindle to wind the tape.
Stereo permalloy head sends microvolt magnetic flux signals to the preamplifier IC.
Amplified stereo audio attenuated by the side volume wheel feeds the 3.5mm headphone socket.

mechanisms.name: Play Engagement & Tape Transport
mechanisms.description: Demonstrates depressing the Play control to advance the magnetic head and pinch roller into the cassette while the DC motor, flywheel, and dual tape reels spin.

stages.title: Stop / Standby State
stages.description: Transport controls are at rest and the magnetic head bridge sits retracted above the cassette shell.

stages.title: Play Button Latched
stages.description: The Play button depresses and pushes the permalloy playback head and rubber pinch roller into contact with the tape and capstan.

stages.title: Belt Drive & Capstan Rotation
stages.description: The 3V DC motor spins the flywheel belt, pulling tape past the stereo head while the supply and take-up reels rotate.

stages.title: Steady Stereo Playback
stages.description: Tape winds smoothly onto the take-up hub while the side volume thumbwheel trims headphone output level.
